description: Checks a pasted `diff all` / `dump` against a release: every `set` line whose setting does not exist, was renamed or removed, or whose value is out of range or not in the value list, plus lines that only repeat the firmware default. The release of the paste is read from its `# Betaflight / ... X.Y.Z` or `# INAV/<target> X.Y.Z` header, which also picks the firmware when none is given. Other commands (aux, serial, resource) are counted, not checked.

firmware.description: Firmware (fw_check_cli: default is the one the paste's header names)

text.description: The CLI text, up to 100 KB

name: fw_check_cli
title: Check a Betaflight or INAV diff
